name: esp32-s3-wroom-1
description: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 Wi-Fi + BLE MCU module with PCB antenna. The module soldered onto many of the boards/ entries; it is a component, not a board. Envelope is the module body; the antenna area is included in the 25.5 mm length.

source.note: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1/1U Datasheet, Version 1.8 (PDF created 2026-03-02), Table 1-1 Specifications on page 3 for identity and description. Entered 2026-08-15 from the same document; migrated 2026-09-06 from OpenDesignCore data/parts/esp32-s3-wroom-1.json; checked against the archived copy 2026-11-06.

Datasheet v1.8, Chapter 4 Boot Configurations on page 13 (strapping pins GPIO0, GPIO3, GPIO45, GPIO46); USB_D- / USB_D+ on GPIO19 / GPIO20 (module pads 13, 14) are from the pin description table on page 11. Entered from: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1/1U Datasheet, section 'Strapping Pins' (GPIO0, GPIO3, GPIO45, GPIO46 sampled at reset to set boot mode, ROM log, VDD_SPI voltage and JTAG source). USB_D- / USB_D+ are GPIO19 / GPIO20 per the pin description table (module pads 13, 14). A design that drives a sensor bus on any of these pins is refused by OpenCircuitCore scripts/make_firmware.py.
Section 10.1 Module Dimensions on page 42 (25.5 +/- 0.2 mm); Table 1-1 on page 3 states the size as 18.0 x 25.5 x 3.1 mm.
